D: Two kids trying to catch Santa on camera crash his sleigh and have to help him save Christmas.
P: Serve the cookies when the kids set up the camera to catch Santa.
S: Stakeout salted caramel choc chip cookies
Chocolate chip cookies with salted caramel centres

Chewy brown sugar cookies loaded with milk chocolate and pockets of salted caramel, left on the plate as bait for Santa. Beat 125g soft butter with 150g brown sugar, 50g caster sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Mix in 220g plain flour, 1/2 tsp bicarb and 120g chopped milk chocolate. Roll into 12 balls, press a soft caramel into the centre of each from a 100g bag and close the dough around it. Chill 20 minutes. Bake at 180C for 11 minutes, sprinkle with sea salt flakes and cool on the tray.
Beef in garlic oregano jus piled onto small rolls

Thin-sliced roast beef dipped in garlic oregano jus and piled into soft slider buns with mild pickled vegetables and a cup of jus for dunking. Simmer 500ml beef stock with 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes and 1 tsp Worcestershire for 10 minutes. Drop in 400g thinly sliced deli roast beef for 1 minute to warm through. Split 8 slider buns and dip the cut sides quickly in the jus. Pile in the beef and top with 150g chopped mild pickled vegetables. Serve with little cups of jus for dunking.
M: Beef meatloaf wrapped in bacon and baked until glazed

Juicy beef meatloaf wrapped in streaky bacon and glazed with sticky tomato and brown sugar, served with creamy mash and gravy. Mix 800g beef mince with 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 60g breadcrumbs soaked in 80ml milk, 2 tsp Worcestershire and salt. Shape into a loaf on a lined tray and wrap with 8 rashers streaky bacon. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, brush with 4 tbsp tomato sauce mixed with 1 tbsp brown sugar and bake 15 minutes more. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and milk. Make gravy from the tray juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml beef stock.
W: Cut-out sugar cookies shaped like reindeer and iced

Vanilla butter cookies cut into reindeer and stars, iced white with a red nose here and there and a scatter of gold sprinkles. Beat 200g butter with 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 1 tsp vanilla, then mix in 300g plain flour. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm, cut reindeer and stars and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Cool. Mix 250g icing sugar with 2 to 3 tbsp water. Ice the cookies white, tint a little red for noses and finish with gold sprinkles.
K: Sleigh ride salted caramel hot chocolate
Hot milk chocolate stirred with salted caramel sauce

Rich milk chocolate hot chocolate stirred with salted caramel, topped with whipped cream, a caramel drizzle and toasted marshmallows. Heat 1L full cream milk until steaming, then whisk in 120g chopped milk chocolate and 4 tbsp salted caramel sauce until smooth. Pour into 4 heatproof mugs. Top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream, drizzle with more caramel and add 2 marshmallows each, browned quickly with a kitchen torch or under the grill.

dishes.n: Stakeout salted caramel choc chip cookies

steps.text: Beat the butter, both sugars, egg and vanilla. Mix in the flour, bicarb and chocolate.
Roll into balls, press a caramel into the centre of each and close the dough around it.
Chill.
Bake at 180C, sprinkle with sea salt and cool on the tray.
Simmer the stock with the garlic, oregano, chilli and Worcestershire.
Drop in the roast beef briefly to warm through.
Split the buns and dip the cut sides quickly in the jus.
Pile in the beef and top with pickled vegetables. Serve with little cups of jus for dunking.
Soak the breadcrumbs in some of the milk, then mix with the mince, onion, egg, Worcestershire and salt.
Shape into a loaf on a lined tray and wrap with the bacon.
Bake at 180C, then brush with the tomato sauce mixed with the sugar and bake again.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and the rest of the milk.
Make gravy from the tray juices with the flour and stock.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep in an airtight container

steps.text: Beat the butter with some of the icing sugar, add the egg yolk and vanilla, then mix in the flour.
Chill the dough.
Roll out and cut reindeer and stars.
Bake at 170C, then cool.
Mix the remaining icing sugar with water. Ice the cookies white, tint a little red for noses and finish with gold sprinkles.

dishes.n: Sleigh ride salted caramel hot chocolate

steps.text: Heat the milk until steaming, then whisk in the chocolate and most of the caramel sauce until smooth.
Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream and a drizzle of caramel.
Add marshmallows and brown quickly with a kitchen torch or under the grill.
